lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in approximately six vertical columns posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs to form anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with high luminance on the dorsal edge and a shadow on the ventral edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct irregular notch or indentation is visible on the posterior margin of the right pectoral fin.
